work.title: Untitled (Diptych with Targets) 1
work.description: Gallery photograph documenting two framed collages displayed side by side. Both works incorporate concentric-ring targets, compact discs, vinyl records, and dense layered paper fragments in red, yellow, magenta, and black; the left panel features a central ivory rectangle, while the right shows figural and typographic elements.
work.composition: two framed works hung side by side
keywords: framed collage pair targets and compact discs
